name: Black Hole Feast: Eat & Grow
subtitle: Swallow Cities & Tasty Treats
promotionalText: Start small, swallow more, and watch a colorful city tumble into your hole. Explore city streets and a food-filled world in timed runs.
description:
There is always room for one more bite.

Guide a hungry hole through colorful streets, collect smaller objects, and grow large enough to swallow bigger surprises before time runs out. Earn coins from your runs and unlock a collection of original hole skins.

- Explore Sunny City, with buildings, moving traffic and a City Tram.
- Visit Snack Garden, a city of food with falling treats and a Sushi Express.
- Watch separate objects tumble into your hole and food stacks collapse.
- Use BOOST to pick up speed and reach your next snack.
- Collect skins across six rarity tiers and choose your favorite look.

Two maps are playable in this version. Additional map cards are marked Coming Soon. Rival holes are computer-controlled; online multiplayer is not included.
reviewNotes: Offline casual physics game. No sign-in or review account is required. Sunny City and Snack Garden are playable; additional map cards are labeled Coming Soon. Rival holes are computer-controlled. There is no online multiplayer. Ads and real-money coin purchases are unavailable in this build; no advertising or purchase SDK is active. Coins are earned during play, and randomized skin unlocks use earned in-game coins with odds disclosed before the unlock. Open INFO on the home screen for the full privacy policy, support contact, credits and complete license texts. The first planned App Store release is United States only. Physical-device acceptance is still in progress.
monetization_status: Not implemented in this candidate; user plans AdMob and Apple IAP later
